customer_message.subject: Request for help contesting termination of my tenancy at Bahnhofstrasse 37, Aarau
customer_message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to ask for help with a dispute about my tenancy at Bahnhofstrasse 37, Aarau, a 2-room flat that I rent from Livit-Partner Verwaltungen AG. The landlord is ending my lease and I want to contest this.

I believe the termination is retaliation. Earlier this year I complained in writing about defects in the flat, including damp in the bathroom and a heating fault that was not repaired for several weeks. I also challenged the rent, which I considered too high. Shortly afterwards the landlord moved to end the tenancy, and I see a clear connection between my complaints and this step.

My tenancy began on 1 October 2017. The agreed net rent is CHF 1430 per month. A copy of the tenancy agreement is attached.

I am not sure whether the landlord's stated reasons are genuine, and I would like your assessment of whether the termination is lawful and whether I can challenge it before the conciliation authority. Please let me know what steps your legal team would recommend and what support your policy can provide.

Thank you for your help. I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Casey Hughes
